name: Darkmantle — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Darkmantle from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Darkmantle" but are not part of the Darkmantle entry, which is unchanged.

Variant: Darkmantle, Darkhood (CR 1)

[Source]

Darkhoods are slightly shorter and wider than darkmantles and have tendrils that are much thinner than a typical specimen.

Envelop Head (Ex)

A darkhood can attempt to strangle and suffocate an opponent with its body and its tendrils when it makes a successful grapple check.

If a target has its head enveloped, it can attempt to break free as a standard action by making a combat maneuver check (DC equal to the dark hood’s CMD +4, usually 17)—this does not provoke an attack of opportunity, or an Escape Artist check (same DC), or by simply attempting to kill the darkhood. However, attacks that hit an enveloping darkhood deal half their damage to the monster and half to the trapped victim.

This replaces a darkmantle’s constrict special attack and darkness spell-like abilities.

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
